title: Zesty Flaky Vietnamese Cookies Bo Kho
description: A jammy, flaky, Vietnamese dish featuring cookies, steam, and a hangover-cure twist, served in a ceramic tagine, shojin-friendly, in the form of bo-kho.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and confectioners sugar.
Add the melted butter to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch and cut into desired shapes.
Place the cookies on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
In a large ceramic tagine, combine the diced apples, bruised lemongrass, whole star anise, and sliced ginger.
Pour in the coconut milk and add the bo kho spice mix and salt.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
To serve, place a few cookies in the bottom of a bowl, then spoon the steaming bo kho mixture over the top.
Cover the bowl with a lid and let steam for 5 minutes before serving.
